basis.zh: 目标接洽池，非已确认意向、订单或预测；当前BUBIX项目阶段均为S0，近期可触达性待核实。
basis.en: A planned outreach pool, not confirmed intent, orders or forecast. All BUBIX-specific entries are S0; current access is unverified.

entry.zh: 原有集团项目接洽线索重新核实；先定位工业、汽车或技术业务中的一个实际法人和流程负责人。
entry.en: Revalidate the prior group-project lead; identify one legal entity and process owner in industrial, automotive or technology operations.

offer.zh: 供应商履约、车辆/设备证照与跨公司验收记录核验；一期仅选一种凭证和两类参与方。
offer.en: Verify supplier performance, vehicle / equipment credentials or cross-entity acceptance records. Start with one credential type and two participant roles.

role.zh: 业务运营负责人＋IT架构＋采购/财务；集团高层负责转介，不替代买方。
role.en: Business operations + IT architecture + procurement / finance. Executive access supports referral, not buyer qualification.

next.zh: D1–7核实旧接口；D8–15安排30分钟问题访谈；D16–30取得匿名样本和流程图。
next.en: D1–7 revalidate access; D8–15 run a 30-minute discovery; D16–30 obtain an anonymized sample and workflow.

gate.zh: 明确付费法人、数据授权人、现有系统及核验成本，才进入有价方案。
gate.en: Confirm paying entity, data authority, current systems and verification cost before a priced proposal.

stop.zh: 若只有集团介绍、无业务负责人或数据样本，保留为资源线索，不进入金额预测。
stop.en: If access stops at a group introduction without a process owner or sample, retain as a lead with no forecast value.

entry.zh: 复核既往集团接洽对应的是Al-Futtaim的具体公司与业务部，避免与Majid Al Futtaim混淆。
entry.en: Confirm the exact Al-Futtaim company and division behind the prior lead; do not conflate it with Majid Al Futtaim.

offer.zh: 汽车售后/供应商跨方凭证、地产供应商对账；优先选单业务单元的小范围流程验证。
offer.en: Cross-party automotive / supplier credentials or property-supplier reconciliation; choose a bounded workflow in one business unit.

role.zh: 业务单元数字化负责人＋供应链/运营＋采购；金融服务仅在许可边界清楚后另议。
role.en: Business-unit digital lead + supply chain / operations + procurement. Financial-service use cases require a separately defined permission boundary.

next.zh: 以一页业务假设请求引荐；确认现有ERP/API及重复核验环节；共同定义基线。
next.en: Request a referral with a one-page use-case hypothesis; establish ERP/API constraints and repeated checks; agree a measurement baseline.

gate.zh: 有跨组织重复核验问题、流程负责人及可开放测试范围。
gate.en: A cross-organization verification problem, accountable process owner and permitted test scope.

stop.zh: 若现有系统已覆盖且无跨方信任问题，不强推上链，转为普通集成评估或退出。
stop.en: If current systems suffice and no cross-party trust problem exists, assess ordinary integration or exit.

entry.zh: 既往商圈项目接洽经验可作为复联入口；先请求转介商管运营、数字化或供应商管理。
entry.en: Prior retail-property engagement provides a recontact hypothesis; seek a referral to mall operations, digital or supplier management.

offer.zh: 租户/供应商履约凭证、工程验收及跨组织对账；先做一项B2B工作流，不从不动产代币发行切入。
offer.en: Tenant / supplier performance evidence, project acceptance or reconciliation. Start with a B2B workflow, not real-estate token issuance.

role.zh: 商管/资产运营负责人＋数字化＋采购法务；租赁经纪入口须转到实际流程买方。
role.en: Property operations + digital + procurement / legal. A leasing intermediary must refer to the actual workflow buyer.

next.zh: D8–15复联；D16–30需求访谈；D31–45形成可评审的流程/SOW。
next.en: D8–15 recontact; D16–30 discovery; D31–45 prepare a reviewable workflow / SOW.

gate.zh: 明确采购法人、数据来源、现有系统边界及可测量验收标准。
gate.en: Confirm purchasing entity, data source, system boundary and measurable acceptance criteria.

stop.zh: 房地产洽谈不等于数字化采购权；未转介到业务买方时不报项目金额。
stop.en: Property discussions do not confer digital procurement authority. No opportunity value before a buyer referral.

entry.zh: 先复核终端生态原接口；再申请转介企业业务/云伙伴团队，两个业务体系分别核实。
entry.en: Revalidate the consumer-ecosystem contact, then request an introduction to enterprise / cloud partners; validate each organization separately.

offer.zh: 联合方案、云/集成适配与共同客户发现；华为是候选渠道，不默认是付款客户。
offer.en: Joint solution design, cloud / integration fit and shared customer discovery. Huawei is a channel candidate, not an assumed paying buyer.

role.zh: 原接口人→企业/云伙伴经理→方案架构师；新团队接受后才进入联合方案。
role.en: Original contact → enterprise / cloud partner manager → solution architect; proceed only after the relevant team accepts the referral.

next.zh: 提交两页技术边界与买方场景；确认转介、伙伴准入、售前资源和商机归属。
next.en: Submit a two-page scope and use-case brief; establish referral, partner onboarding, presales resources and opportunity ownership.

gate.zh: 伙伴团队确认技术适配和共同客户；渠道引荐与最终客户收入分开。
gate.en: Partner-team confirmation, technical fit and a named end customer. Separate referrals from end-customer revenue.

stop.zh: 终端流量合作经验不等于华为云/政企业务授权；不得把184.8万月活当BUBIX可售客户。
stop.en: Consumer-traffic experience is not cloud / enterprise authorization; the 1.848m audience claim is not BUBIX sales inventory.

entry.zh: 从生态/商品贸易团队进入，争取定位1–2家独立贸易成员；成员企业须单独确认。
entry.en: Enter through ecosystem / commodity teams and identify 1–2 independent member traders; qualify each member separately.

offer.zh: 现有Tradeflow等平台之外的凭证衔接或跨境协同缺口；先调查互补价值，不宣称替代既有基础设施。
offer.en: Investigate credential interoperability or cross-border gaps outside existing platforms such as Tradeflow; establish complementarity, not a replacement claim.

role.zh: 生态/商品业务团队＋候选贸易企业运营、财务与IT；DMCC不自动作为平台买方。
role.en: Ecosystem / commodity teams + trader operations, finance and IT. DMCC is not automatically the platform buyer.

next.zh: D8–15确认准入路径；D16–30访谈成员痛点；D31–45选择可提供样本的贸易机构。
next.en: D8–15 confirm access route; D16–30 interview members; D31–45 select a trader able to supply test data.

gate.zh: 至少一家独立买方确认需求、数据权限和采购路径；每家单独建账户。
gate.en: At least one independent buyer confirms need, data rights and procurement path; create a distinct account for each.

stop.zh: 自由区设立、生态活动或会员身份不等于订单；未形成独立买方不计销售机会。
stop.en: Registration, events or membership are not orders; no qualified opportunity without an independent buyer.

accounts.name: 海南佳寿 / 鳄宇宙 · Hainan Jiashou

entry.zh: 复联既往独立顾问项目，先确认公司主体、项目现状及资料使用授权。
entry.en: Recontact the prior advisory project; confirm legal entity, present status and permission to use materials.

offer.zh: 实体产业身份、批次记录与贸易凭证演示样本；只作为待验证技术/案例入口。
offer.en: Industrial identity, batch records and trade-credential demonstration; a candidate validation / reference route.

role.zh: 现任经营负责人＋数字产品/供应链负责人；境外买方另行确认。
role.en: Current business lead + digital-product / supply-chain owner. Qualify any overseas buyer separately.

next.zh: 核验旧项目状态，取得可公开或脱敏的业务样本；BUBIX技术团队评估可复用性。
next.en: Verify project status, obtain authorized anonymized samples, and assess reusability with BUBIX engineers.

gate.zh: 授权样本、真实记录、场景适配通过；有独立采购需求才建销售机会。
gate.en: Authorized real-world sample and technical fit; create a sales opportunity only for independent paid demand.

stop.zh: 国内项目不记作中东收入；资产数量、NFA概念或旧项目经历不计为新订单。
stop.en: Do not count domestic activity as Middle East revenue, or asset quantities / NFA concepts / past work as new orders.

entry.zh: 沙特战略商务资源列为待核实引荐路径；先确定具体企业、授权与业务负责人。
entry.en: Treat Saudi strategic access as an unverified referral route; identify a legal entity, authority and business owner first.

offer.zh: 产业供应链或资产记录的企业级场景；国家级底座作为后续机会，不列90日必达签约。
offer.en: Enterprise supply-chain or asset-record use cases. National infrastructure is a later opportunity, not a required 90-day contract.

role.zh: 实际运营公司＋采购机构；关系通路不等于政府或基金授权。
role.en: Actual operating company and purchasing body; access does not confer government or fund authorization.

next.zh: 先书面确认转介主体和最小商业问题，符合门槛再安排出访。
next.en: Confirm referring entity and a bounded business problem in writing before travel.

gate.zh: 具名买方、业务赞助、预算路径及本地交付条件齐备。
gate.en: Named buyer, business sponsor, budget path and local delivery conditions.

stop.zh: 没有具体买方就保持储备，不把PIF/NEOM等整个生态记为客户。
stop.en: Remain a reserve route without a buyer; never count an entire PIF / NEOM ecosystem as a customer.

entry.zh: 泛阿拉伯顾问/机构资源仅作为行业交流与转介入口，先核验证明文件及授权范围。
entry.en: Use pan-Arab advisory / institutional access only for industry dialogue and referrals, subject to credentials and authority verification.

offer.zh: 小范围行业闭门交流，寻找明确需求的产业买方；不按覆盖国家数量放大商机。
offer.en: Small industry roundtables to identify buyers with specific needs; country coverage does not multiply opportunities.

role.zh: 机构业务协调方＋独立产业买方；双方责任分别确认。
role.en: Institutional coordinator and independent industry buyer; establish responsibilities separately.

next.zh: 先确认职衔/证书、当前联系与活动授权；拿到具名企业转介后进入常规销售流程。
next.en: Verify credentials, current access and event authority; enter normal sales qualification only after a named company referral.

gate.zh: 具体企业、业务问题和可安排的工作会议。
gate.en: Specific company, business problem and an agreed working meeting.

stop.zh: 顾问身份不等于22国采购、政府授权或收入保证。
stop.en: Advisory status is not procurement authority across 22 countries or a revenue guarantee.
